label: Step-index fiber (straight)

clad_diameter.help: cladding outer diameter (240 um typical for a 200 um core)

core_diameter.help: core diameter (200 um typical large-core multimode)

gap.help: core/cladding modeling air gap (the 5 um optical-contact convention; do not set to 0)

tooltip: Straight step-index multimode fiber segment along +x: analytic-cylinder core plus a concentric cladding annulus, flat polished end faces at x=0 and x=length. Defaults model a 200 um-core 0.22-NA silica fiber (core material fiber_core_na22 vs fused_silica cladding; swap either body's 'material' property to change the NA). The core/cladding boundary uses the standard 5 um modeling air gap (optically-contacted solids don't exist, docs/RAYTRACER.md) -- guided rays launched inside the fiber NA still TIR at the core wall exactly as they should; only rays OUTSIDE the NA behave differently (they TIR at the core|gap interface instead of refracting away into the cladding), so leaky/cladding-mode power is not quantitative. Two bodies.
